description: Mark a pull request ready for review (`draft: false`) or convert it back to a draft (`draft: true`). GitHub exposes this only through GraphQL (markPullRequestReadyForReview / convertPullRequestToDraft), so the reply is that mutation's `pullRequest` object, not the REST one. A pull request already in the requested state is returned as is.

draft.description: true = convert to draft; false = ready.
